title: Quantifying Statistical Significance in Diffusion-Based Anomaly Localization via Selective Inference
reasoning: The paper focuses on quantifying statistical significance and technical reliability for anomaly localization in high-stakes domains like medical diagnosis and industrial inspection. While ensuring reliability is crucial for responsible AI, the paper does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as its primary subject matter. It addresses technical safeguards to mitigate model uncertainty and bias, which are related to model safety and trustworthiness, rather than ethical frameworks or moral reasoning itself.
